card.name: Joining co-author names in citations
card.fires_on: The joining mark between author names in reference lists or reading recommendations, such as &, and, by, or an initial before a surname. It fires just before the next author's name.

modes.label: Author joiner
modes.description: The & or 'and' linking two authors' names in a citation.
modes.example: D. Koller<< &>> N. Friedman’s Probabilistic Graph

modes.label: Initials in names
modes.description: A middle initial or a period after an initial, inside an author name in a bibliography.
modes.example: Katherine A.<< S>>. Sibley, John Earl Hay

modes.label: Before author after title
modes.description: The word 'by' after a book title, ahead of the author's name.
modes.example: Introduction to Statistical Relational Learning<< by>> Lise Getoor & Ben Taskar

card.plain: It marks the spot in a reference list where one author's name ends and the next author's name is about to start.
